62100.description:
With a carefree outlook on life, Hiroto knows better than anyone that slowing down is sometimes the best way to move forward.

At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn’t have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn’t be happier. Hiroto’s breezy attitude isn’t easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people who surround him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life.

After developing an unlikely friendship with the grouchy old granny who lives in his neighborhood, Hiroto suddenly finds himself inheriting not just her house, but some rather difficult emotions as well. His 18-year-old cousin Natsumi moves in with him, but as a struggling art student, she has her own troubles to deal with and may just put Hiroto’s easygoing lifestyle to the test.

(Source: VIZ Media)

62102.description:
Miya is the illegitimate child of a prominent family. When her mother dies and her father’s estate agrees to take her in, she’s convinced she knows what awaits her in her new home: a life of servitude and misery at the hands of her wicked stepmother and stepsisters. Yet when she finally meets the women she expects to treat her like dirt, they actually end up being…sweet?! A hilarious and heartfelt comedy that’s sure to put a smile on your face!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: いびってこない義母と義姉

62106.description:
Amane Kujou, a virgin girl frustrated with her chaste boyfriend who only kisses her, channels her energy into the track and field club. However, her strong sexual desire, typical of an athlete, fuels her growing frustration. To make matters worse, a middle-aged man can’t stop staring at her provocative athletic uniform.

Living alone in an apartment, Amane indulges in nightly masturbation. Unbeknownst to her, the middle-aged landlord secretly records her behavior!

In exchange for deleting the videos, he demands a one-sided physical relationship.

Though unwanted, Amane’s unsatisfied body begins to crave the man’s touch more and more… What will become of Amane?!

title.native: 彼女がセパレートをまとう理由
title.romaji: Kanojo ga Separate wo Matou Riyuu

62117.description:
To clear suspicion, words are the weakest defense. True power speaks for itself! General Zichuan Xiu, who once single-handedly executed a traitor of the Zichuan clan within the Demon Clan's stronghold, has risen to command hundreds of thousands of allied troops in the Far East. Supported by the Guardian Elders of the Sacred Temple, this warrior now ascends as the new sovereign of the Eastern lands: The Bright King is crowned!

(Source: WeTV)

62120.description: A special animation to commemorate Mobile Suit Gundam Wing's 30th anniversary, directed by Tooru Iwazawa.

title.romaji: Shin Kidou Senki Gundam Wing: operation 30th

62126.description:
SI-VIS is a co-ed music group, led by Yosuke, shaking up the global music scene with their unmatched vocals and performances. However, they are actually heroes in disguise, battling against mysterious forces threatening the world. They convert audience energy at live performances into combat power. Luckily, the battles appear to be ordinary concerts to the public, keeping their identity a secret.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

62136.description: Music video directed by Tomomi Umetsu for the song Suki-Suki Diesuki Chou Ayeshiteru by Houshou Marine.

62144.description: Kaede, an ordinary high school girl, suddenly wakes up in an unfamiliar alleyway—only to realize she's been transported to a mysterious world inhabited by beastmen, elves, and dragons. Among her belongings, she discovers a strange book that wasn't there before. To her surprise, it allows her to create potions simply by chanting the word "create." Relying on these potions to survive, Kaede navigates the challenges of this fantastical world while clinging to the hope of one day returning to Japan. Her journey of struggle and discovery in this otherworldly realm is just beginning...

title.english: I Saved Myself with a Potion!: Life in Another World
title.native: ポーション、わが身を助ける
Hな義姉シリーズ The Animation

62146.description:
Using his Almighty Farming Tool, Hiraku Machio continues transforming his village into an even livelier community as new residents from across the region find refuge there. As he tends the fields that first brought everyone together, Hiraku gradually takes on a greater role by guiding the village's growth not only as the chief but also as a father, ensuring that each day counts.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Note: World premiere of Episode 1 before the Japanese television premiere occurred at ANIMONIUM in Bangkok February 8, 2026

62149.description:
He is lost in every possible sense, on every possible subject, including (but not limited to): how much space there is left in the Spirit Origin Storage, when one should use an item that looks kind of important, or even what the daily special is today.

The slapstick anime where Fujimaru’s naive questions throw the Heroic Spirits into turmoil returns for that trick!

(Source: Official Website)

62157.description:
Tall, blonde and blue-eyed, it is impossible not to notice Isak Borg, First Secretary to the Swedish Embassy in Pyongyang. As a diplomat, he is under constant surveillance and strongly discouraged from interacting with the locals. Despite this, he secretly dates Bok-joo, a local traffic officer, but when one last effort to extend his stay is rejected, Isak begs her to come back to Stockholm with him. Bok-joo turns this idea down and abruptly disappears. Oblivious to the danger he is putting the woman he loves in, Isak asks Myeong-jun, his assigned interpreter, for help. When Myeong-jun refuses, a desperate Isak becomes increasingly suspicious of everyone.

(Source: Tribeca Film)

62164.description:
"With only your voice and body—master the art."

Akane Ousaki, captivated since childhood by the magical performances of her father, Shinta Arakawa, witnesses a shocking incident during his decisive performance for promotion to shin’uchi (master rank).

Six years later, now a high school student, she sets her sights on becoming a shin’uchi herself—pushing forward in the highly competitive world of rakugo.

A passionate and authentic rakugo drama begins now!

(Source: TV Asahi, edited)
synonyms: อาคาเนะ พลิกตำนานวงการราคุโกะ

62165.description:
In the vast Jiang Dynasty, the culture of swordsmanship has been passed down for millennia, and the people take pride in practicing it. However, reaching its pinnacle, the "Sword God Realm," is a rare feat. Over a decade ago, the once-powerful Wuji Sword God was severely injured by the schemes of the Changsheng Sword God, forcing him to retreat into seclusion in the mountains, detached from worldly affairs.

Now, Zhan Yibai, Wuji Sword God's only disciple, has finally come of age, and the time has arrived for him to embark on a journey of training as agreed upon by master and disciple. Before departing, to enhance Zhan Yibai's self-defense abilities, Wuji Sword God gifted him his personal sword and instructed him to rapidly achieve the realm of Sword God. New to the secular world, Zhan Yibai befriends Jiang Mingyue, Princess of the dynasty, and Li Kuang, the second son of the Prince of Zhennan. Hoping to rapidly grow, he and his companions participate in the "Ancient Dynasty Ruins" trial, embarking on a remarkable journey.

62166.description: Pan Gaofeng, a young rocket development engineer born in the 1980s, joined the First Academy of Aerospace Science and Technology, the cradle of my country's launch vehicles, after graduating from graduate school. He was fortunate to be a member of the development team for the Long March 5 (CZ-5), my country's most powerful launch vehicle. Working alongside his predecessors and colleagues, he overcame numerous difficulties, overcame obstacles, and defied external ridicule and skepticism. He rose from the ashes of a failed launch to ultimately achieve success, marking a crucial step in my country's transition from a major space power to a leading space power.

62167.description:
Dongfang Shaohong, possessing two Dao bodies, but lacking the spiritual roots to awaken his spirit body, is ridiculed by his own clan and even betrayed by his fiancée. Troubles pile up one after another. Dongfang Shaohong's father, imprisoned for possessing the secret to entering the Cangyu Immortal Palace, is trapped by the Immortal Alliance. In the midst of his clan's crisis, Dongfang Shaohong inadvertently uses his own blood to activate the Dao Stone of Immortal Source within him, repelling the Immortal Alliance and saving the clan from the brink. In these dire straits, Dongfang Shaohong is fortunately rescued by his father's friend, Master Ji Yin, and is offered refuge within the Piaomiao Sect. Within the Taiyin Mountain ravine of the Piaomiao Sect, Dongfang Shaohong diligently cultivates, but possessing the Dark Night Dao Body of the Nether Clan is viewed as an anomaly among the human race and constantly harassed by his fellow disciples. Dongfang Shaohong realizes that only by becoming powerful enough can he rescue his father, clear his name, and expose the Immortal Alliance's conspiracy.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)
synonyms: Legend of the Misty Sword Immortal

62171.description:
Spica Virgo is an apprentice witch, but can’t use any magic. She needs someone to be her master in order to get into the academy of her dreams, but she has no money and no connections. Suddenly, a mysterious talking black cat that can use magic appears before her!! Spica wants to learn magic, and the black cat wants his curse broken—goals on the same path. Therefore, a secret master-apprentice relationship was born! But the key to breaking the curse is kissing his…?! A clumsy witch and the teachings of a black cat—the magic academy fantasy starts here!!

(Source: K Manga)
synonyms: The Classroom of a Black Cat and a Witch

title.english: The Classroom of the Black Cat and a Witch

62187.description:
Elizabeth was known as a villainess but in fact, she was a decent and honest girl. But she was accused by mistake, found guilty and exiled...but she accepted her situation. That was because...she had her memory from her previous life as an event planner in Japan, and she knew what was coming. She was in the Otome game world she loved!! She started enjoying her life as an apprentice to sisters at Church of Nortia which is located in a rural village. And she doesn't have to follow the story from here!! Now Elizabeth can using her skill from her previous life, to make her life easier. No one's noticing, so this will be OK, right? But then, the knight commander moves close and tells her he's watching. What does he want?

(Source: Kadokawa)
synonyms: The Banished Villainess! Living the Leisurely Life of a Nun Making Revolutionary Church Food

title.native: 悪役令嬢の追放後！ 教会改革ごはんで悠々シスター暮らし
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou no Tsuihougo! Kyoukai Kaikaku Gohan de Yuuyuu Sister Kurashii

62188.description:
Reincarnated as a vampire to a noble father and his shunned concubine, Mercedes Grunewald has always known that one day, her father will choose an heir that isn't her. But what will become of her family when that time comes? Her mother has no skills, their maid is old, and Mercedes is but a small child. How will they survive in the world on their own?

Luckily, dungeon crawling is a job that anyone can do—even a child. To provide for her family, Mercedes begins training at the age of a kindergartener, and because she's from a nation of vampires, she fortunately has the potential to become strong. In her past life, she died unfulfilled, but that won't be her fate this time. In the dungeons, she's determined to find something that will make her moon full.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Mercedes and the Waning Moon: The Dungeoneering Feats of a Discarded Vampire Aristocrat
欠けた月のメルセデス～吸血鬼の貴族に転生したけど捨てられそうなのでダンジョンを制覇する
Kaketa Tsuki no Mercedes: Kyuuketsuki no Kizoku ni Tensei Shitakedo Sute Rare Sounanode Dungeon wo Seiha Suru

title.native: 欠けた月のメルセデス

62193.description:
"I want to blossom, in this city."

The story follows two Japanese girls who never give up in reaching for étoile (stars) during the difficult times at the start of 20th century. Fujiko, who dreams of becoming a painter, and Chizuru, who is drawn into the world of ballet, meet by chance in Yokohama. Then, as if guided by fate, they meet again in Paris and work hard to follow their dreams together.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: パリに咲くエトワール

62194.description:
Crimson refers to the color crimson or bright red, and the concept of this volume is "monsters." This is a collection of horror stories that carefully selects masterpieces filled with unique madness, allowing you to immerse yourself in the eerie, bizarre, and yet original world of Junji Ito.

(Source: Official Website, translated)
